latest.title: Luke Bryan | This Past Weekend w/ Theo Von #679
latest.desc:
Luke Bryan is a multi-platinum country singer, songwriter and host. His new album “Signs” is out September 18th.

Luke joins Theo to talk about watching his son’s journey in football, experimenting with new meats in the future, and the reaction to his viral song “Fish Hunt Golf Drink.”
